syscalls.comment: Networking for database connections. Includes client accept/connect for incoming queries and replication.

File I/O, memory management, process lifecycle. flock for lock files (PostgreSQL postmaster.pid, Redis RDB). fdatasync for WAL durability without metadata sync. sync_file_range for async data flush. mremap for memory-mapped storage engines. preadv2/pwritev2 for async I/O. Includes getgroups/getresgid/getresuid for privilege-dropping databases.
Thread creation for connection pooling and background workers.
Runtime support: random for query IDs and nonces, rseq for Go/C runtimes, arch_prctl for x86_64 setup.
Full System V shared memory: PostgreSQL shared_buffers, MongoDB WiredTiger cache, MySQL InnoDB buffer pool. shmctl added for shared memory control operations (IPC_STAT, IPC_RMID).
Time syscalls for query timing, WAL timestamps, connection timeouts, and replication lag measurement. clock_nanosleep added for high-resolution sleep in background workers.
File pre-allocation for WAL files (PostgreSQL pg_wal, MySQL redo log), temporary sort files, and data files. fadvise64 for sequential/random access pattern hints to the kernel.

Directory and permission management. chdir/fchdir for data directory context (PostgreSQL requires chdir to data dir). chmod/fchmod for Unix socket permissions (PostgreSQL .s.PGSQL.port, MongoDB mongod.sock).

Privilege dropping. PostgreSQL starts as root to bind port 5432 then drops to postgres user. Redis switches to redis user. All databases that support running as non-root need these for UID/GID switching at startup.
Resource limit management. Databases raise RLIMIT_NOFILE for connection limits and lower RLIMIT_CORE to prevent core dumps containing sensitive data.
Memory barrier for multi-core synchronization in concurrent database engines. Used by PostgreSQL for buffer manager coordination and MongoDB for journaling.
Zero-copy file range duplication. Used by PostgreSQL for base backups and COPY operations, reducing CPU overhead for large data transfers.
Timer file descriptors for connection keepalive, replication heartbeat, WAL flush intervals, and statement timeout enforcement.
Cross-process memory read for PostgreSQL parallel query workers sharing buffer state.
